name: bash
description: Run commands in a bash shell. State is persistent across command calls. The bash command to run. Relative path is preferred in the command.

name: str_replace_editor
description: Custom editing tool for viewing, creating and editing files. Commands: view, create, str_replace, insert.

name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a file at a workdir-relative path.

name: edit_file
description: Replace a unique string in a file with another (supports batch).

name: glob
description: Find files matching a glob pattern.

name: grep
description: Search file contents with a regular expression.

name: git
description: Run read-only git inspection commands (status, diff, log).
